it does not expressly cover all foreign-service personnel.","The excerpt supports strict discipline and political conduct, but does not expressly state anti-corruption standards."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0004-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0004-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0004-E011","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0004-E012","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0004-E013","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0004-E014","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The October 2023 Central Financial Work Conference stated that financial risks remained numerous, financial services to the real economy were insufficiently effective, financial disorder and corruption persisted, and financial regulatory and governance capacity was weak.","notes":["The excerpt establishes that Xi attended and spoke at the conference, but does not state that he chaired it or that he personally adopted the finding."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0004-E015","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The conference called for directing more financial resources toward technological innovation, advanced manufacturing, green development, and small and micro-enterprises;
